newsitem.title: INDIA: Explosion injures at least 15 on India train.
newsitem.headline: Explosion injures at least 15 on India train.

text.p: At least 15 people were injured in an explosion on Monday in a passenger train in southern India, local news agencies said.
United News of India (UNI) said a bomb exploded on the train in Karnataka state, but the Press Trust of India (PTI) said authorities had not yet determined the cause of the blast.
UNI said 17 people were injured, while PTI said at least 15 were hurt.
PTI quoted a local police officer as saying the train was near Kolar, about 70 km (40 miles) northeast of the Karnataka capital Bangalore, when the explosion occurred.
The train had started its voyage in Madurai in neighbouring Tamil Nadu state and was headed to Bangalore, the agencies said.
